step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier with a tail current source and an active PMOS current mirror load. Given the active loads, it is likely used as an IF amplifier (9.45 MHz) or a wideband LNA in the GPS receiver front-end.

paper_reference.title: A 35-mW 3.6-mm2 Fully Integrated 0.18-m CMOS GPS Radio

Voltage Gain (1.575 GHz).description: Small-signal voltage gain at the GPS L1 RF frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm ~ 1.5mS, Rout ~ 32kOhm. DC gain ~ 33 dB. At 1.575 GHz, parasitic capacitance (~20fF) reduces gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Active PMOS loads limit high-frequency gain compared to inductive loads, but 15-20 dB is achievable.

Voltage Gain (9.45 MHz).description: Small-signal voltage gain at the IF frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: At 9.45 MHz, the amplifier operates close to its DC open-loop gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Thermal noise of diff pair and active loads. Typical CMOS LNA NF is 2-5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Active loads contribute additional noise compared to inductive loads, slightly raising the NF.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the amplifier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: A single amplifier stage consumes a small fraction of the total 35 mW radio power.

3dB Bandwidth.description: Frequency where the voltage gain drops by 3 dB from its DC value.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). Rout ~ 32kOhm, Cout ~ 10fF -> BW ~ 500 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the output node parasitic capacitance and output resistance.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain at IF and RF frequencies, 3dB bandwidth, and Noise Figure. Uses a large L/C feedback network to stabilize the DC operating point while allowing open-loop AC measurements.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential LNA / IF Amplifier Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 LABEL_NET_3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 LABEL_NET_4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_5 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biases
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
* Restore missing diode connection for current mirror load (XM2 G=N2 implies XM4 is diode-connected)
V_short LABEL_NET_2 N2 0
* Turn off auxiliary PMOS devices to isolate the main diff pair
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8

* Inputs with L/C feedback for DC stability
V_INP LABEL_NET_3 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5
V_INN_bias INN_bias 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5

* 1T Henry inductor closes loop at DC, open at AC
L_fb N0 LABEL_NET_5 1T
* 1T Farad capacitor couples AC input, open at DC
C_ac INN_bias LABEL_NET_5 1T

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 50 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N0)
  meas ac gain_dc find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac gain_9M find gain_db at=9.45Meg
  meas ac gain_1G5 find gain_db at=1.575G
  
  let gain_3db = gain_dc - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
  
  * 3. Noise Analysis at 1.575 GHz
  noise v(N0) V_INP dec 50 1G 2G
  setplot noise1
  meas noise inoise_1G5 find inoise_spectrum at=1.575G
  * Calculate Noise Figure (assuming 50 Ohm source, 4kT*50 = 8.28e-21)
  let nf_db = 10 * log10( (inoise_1G5 * inoise_1G5) / 8.28e-21 )
  print nf_db
  
  quit
.endc
.end
